data.description: 阳光明媚的水上乐园休息区，拉菲艾拉穿白色露肩上衣与牛仔短裤，蜷在躺椅里扶着遮阳伞柄打盹。伞下柔影映着远处水面细碎的亮光，她迷糊地伸手抓住观众的衣角。

data.promptProse: La Pluma curls into the beach chair with one arm around the parasol shaft, her free hand lightly catching the viewer's sleeve. The canopy shades her drowsy face while reflected water sparkles beyond its edge.
data.title: 羽毛笔 · 夏卉日光浴
